Instrumental woodland border-village exploration cue. Warm muted plucked strings and soft reed melody, an original simple three-note ward motif, sparse hand percussion and a faint unsettled low texture. Calm forward motion, no vocals, no grand finale; choose a phrase suitable for a 32-bar loop.

Intimate instrumental inn cue related to the accepted village motif: solo plucked strings, quiet bowed support, close dry room, safety with restrained unease. Sparse arrangement leaves dialogue intelligible. No crowd sounds baked into music, no vocals.

Instrumental old-road exploration cue using the accepted ward motif in sparse broken phrases. Low strings, breathy reed and light wooden pulses; exposed and uncertain rather than constant battle intensity. No wind or footsteps baked into music.

Instrumental shrine cue: a few widely spaced plucked notes echo the ward motif over low sustained strings and restrained bell-like tones. Reflective, unresolved, never horror jump scares; no speech, choir or environmental wind.
Quiet woodland village ambience: soft distant leaves and a few sparse birds, no speech, animals close to microphone, music or dramatic events. Stable bed, clean repeat.
Small inn room ambience: restrained fireplace crackle and subtle timber settling. No people speaking, dishes slamming or music. Stable quiet room, smooth loop.
Exposed woodland road ambience: gentle cool wind through sparse leaves, distant stream, occasional tiny branch creak. No music, voices or threatening jumps.
Quiet ruined shrine ambience: light air through stone openings, a few distant leaves, spacious but subtle. No chanting, melody, voices, impacts or tonal drone.
One old timber gate creak and gentle latch release, close dry recording, short natural tail. Single action, no footsteps, voices or music.
One timber inn door latch and gentle door swing, close and dry, no slam, footsteps, music or voices.
One short dry parchment unfold and soft finger movement, subtle readable paper texture, no voice or music.
One small metal-and-wood ward component lifted with a restrained mechanical click, concise feedback, no musical tune or speech.
One soft magical ward pulse: woody resonant tap with a very short glassy shimmer, gentle not explosive, no speech or repeating melody.
One boot step on dry fine gravel, close dry Foley, single strike and crunch, no walking sequence or music.
One boot step on an old timber floor, dry and restrained, no squeal, multi-step sequence or music.
One quiet stone contact and brief clear resonant chime for a confirmed shrine interaction. No song, voice, long echo or explosive transient.
